quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (H1 2026 results briefing): chairman and general manager Chen Lu said H1 metrology-equipment revenue grew more slowly than the company average because of normal seasonality and the timing of customer acceptance and revenue recognition, and based on orders on hand and new-product validation he expects full-year revenue to keep growing at a relatively high rate. He expects 2026 global and mainland-China demand for inspection and metrology equipment to grow year on year, driven by faster AI-infrastructure investment and more spending on leading-edge logic, advanced memory (including HBM) and advanced packaging, and is optimistic about inspection and metrology order growth in H2 and for full-year 2026. CFO Zhou Fannü said H1 gross margin was hit short term by a higher share of lower-margin advanced-packaging revenue and low introductory pricing of some new products; front-end and advanced-process orders exceed 80% of orders on hand, so she expects the full-year front-end revenue share to return to its normal range, the advanced-process contribution to rise and gross margin to stay at a relatively high level, with expense ratios trending down as scale grows.
quarterly_data.figure: front-end and advanced-process orders over 80% of orders on hand

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products (H1 2026 results briefing): chairman Chen Lu said the company has launched thirteen equipment series across optical, e-beam and X-ray technology covering over 70% of the semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment market, of which eleven series have passed leading domestic customers' line validation and are selling. In H1 the mature-node brightfield tool and the X-ray TSV copper-fill void metrology tool passed leading domestic customers' validation; line validation of the advanced-node brightfield nano-pattern defect inspection tool is going smoothly, with more positive results hoped for within the year; the wafer flatness metrology tool's validation at a leading domestic HBM customer is going smoothly; and the e-beam CD metrology tool has shipped to a leading customer's line for validation. Overseas, unpatterned and patterned defect inspection, 3D topography and dielectric film-thickness tools passed several overseas advanced-packaging customers' line validation and are in volume sales, and unpatterned inspection and dielectric film-thickness tools shipped to overseas advanced-process customers for line validation; H1 2026 overseas revenue exceeded RMB 5,000 ten-thousand and he sees large room for growth.
quarterly_data.figure: thirteen series covering over 70% of the market; eleven series validated and selling; H1 overseas revenue over RMB 5,000 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply chain (H1 2026 results briefing): chairman Chen Lu said the company has invested heavily in technical cooperation with domestic component suppliers, and its upstream component localisation can now meet volume-production needs of each equipment series for the most advanced domestic process customers as well as R&D toward more advanced processes; forward-looking planning with domestic suppliers lets new tools move smoothly into volume production with stable supply to customers.
